title: fix(hooks): [HIMMEL-6957] guard-agent-model pins console-judge-ro to opus
body:
## Summary

`guard-agent-model.sh` refused an off-Opus model override for `console-judge` but not for `console-judge-ro`, the read-only judge the console actually dispatches. A `console-judge-ro` dispatch with `model: sonnet` and no `ESCALATION:` reason passed. The match is now `(^|:)console-judge(-[a-z0-9-]+)?$`, so every `console-judge-*` agent (including a plugin-namespaced one and any added later) is pinned to Opus.

Note: the ticket named `scripts/hooks/test-guard-subagent-model.sh` as the suite, but that suite tests `guard-subagent-model.sh` (missing-model deny). The suite that covers this hook is `scripts/hooks/test-guard-agent-model.sh`, so the rows went there (console approved the narrowing).

## Proof

- RED (hook unfixed): `test-guard-agent-model.sh` 68 passed, 3 failed: `console-judge-ro + sonnet`, `console-judge-ro + haiku`, `plugin-namespaced console-judge-ro + sonnet`, each expected block, got allow.
- GREEN (fixed): all rows pass, including `console-judge-ro + opus`, `+ claude-opus-5-5`, `+ no model`, `+ sonnet + ESCALATION marker` allowed, `console-judge-future + sonnet` denied, and `console-judgement + sonnet` still allowed (not a judge agent). Existing `console-judge` rows unchanged.

## Impacted suites

- `scripts/hooks/test-guard-agent-model.sh`: run locally, pass.
- Every other suite from `impacted-suites.sh`: SKIP CI-gated per decision 101 (GitHub CI is the gate).

No new suite, so no `suite-tiers.tsv` / `suite-durations.tsv` rows. `scripts/hooks/guard-agent-model.sh` matches a ci-trust-paths pattern (`^scripts/hooks/(block|guard|cadence-deny)-`), so this needs a trust-reviewed GO.

## Ticket coverage

- Refuse an off-Opus model override for console-judge-ro like console-judge: done
- Cover any judge agent added later: done
